	possible = { has_variable = pmr_dam_piave_valley_months }
	when_taken = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_piave_valley_months
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_stop|piave_valley|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}
	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { in_default = yes }
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_yili_river_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = steam_turbine
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_yili_river_surveyed }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_yili_river_surveying }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_yili_river_claim }
		NOT = { p:x71C144.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_yili_river  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:x71C144 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		produced_bureaucracy > 700
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_yili_river_begin_survey = yes
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
	}
}

		has_technology_researched = electrical_generation
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_surveyed }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_surveying }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_claim }
		NOT = { p:x02F3AF.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_lawpita_falls  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:x02F3AF ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		produced_bureaucracy > 500
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_begin_survey = yes
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
	}
}

pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_stop_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = { has_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months }
	possible = { has_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months }
	when_taken = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_stop|lawpita_falls|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}
	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { in_default = yes }
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = {
		has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed
		NOT = { p:x3F0EE7 ?= { state ?= { owner ?= ROOT } } }
		p:x3F0EE7 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_financing }
		p:x3F0EE7.state ?= {
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  is_under_construction = yes } }
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level_after_queued_constructions >= 19 } }
			OR = { AND = { NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river } } ROOT = { has_technology_researched = steam_turbine } } AND = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 1 } NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 2 } } ROOT = { has_technology_researched = arc_welding } } AND = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 2 } NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 3 } } ROOT = { has_technology_researched = arc_welding } } AND = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 3 } NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 4 } } ROOT = { has_technology_researched = arc_welding } } AND = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 4 } NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level >= 5 } } ROOT = { has_technology_researched = arc_welding } } AND = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = 		has_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_surveyed
		NOT = { p:x5F00C0 ?= { state ?= { owner ?= ROOT } } }
		p:x5F00C0 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_financing }
		p:x5F00C0.state ?= {
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_sariyar_gorge  is_under_construction = yes } }
			NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_sariyar_gorge  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } }
			OR = { AND = { NOT = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_sariyar_gorge } } ROOT = { has_technology_researched = steam_turbine } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_sariyar_gorge_begin_finance = yes
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
	}
}
